Stop and report on any breach.

Premise: to verify first on `origin/main`. The derived modal form for an object with `fieldGroups` and no authored layout draws a row of group items over stacked sections. Clicking one moves only the highlight (#35125 made a grouped dialog's section-nav jump scroll the form only, so the row may be a scroll anchor bar whose jump does nothing when the content fits). The fix makes the row honest: either it switches the content, or it does not look like tabs and visibly takes the reader to the section.
Serial constraints cleared: none. A live read of all 48 open PRs' files at claim time found none touching `GridField.tsx` or the `plugin-form` form files.
Pre-claim deps: none. There is no parent issue.
Prior rulings read: fieldTabs, tabbed, fieldGroups → no ruling id hit. The section-nav fix #35125 (3446f234) is read as context, not as a ruling.
Review path: L1-a. Seat L2 only if `packages/spec` is touched (it is not planned). Approver handoff if Tier H or over 3,000 lines.

Delivered:
- The group row on a derived create/edit dialog was a scroll-to-section bar styled like tabs. It now shows "# group" jump pills.
- The bar is hidden whenever every section fits, so a click can no longer do nothing. When it is shown, a click scrolls to the section and briefly marks its heading.
- Authored tabbed layouts and the record detail page are unchanged. The full-page form's jump bar follows the same rule.
